exclusion_reason: Every declared calling convention (cdecl, stdcall, fastcall, thiscall) lowers to a balanced guest stack and the real guest->host crossing cost is measured as the WebAssembly import call the recompiled path uses, but the crossing-cost bar is a BPTK-002 reference-desktop figure not certified on this host and the whole Win32 HLE is not yet wired into the recompiled crossing, so the end-to-end boundary stays red.
promotion_trigger: Promote to passing when every convention reaches the whole Win32 HLE with correct cleanup and the measured crossing cost stays under the declared bar on the pinned reference desktop.
expected_failing_assertion: The measured boundary is the raw WebAssembly import call rather than a whole Win32 HLE crossing, and the cost bar is a reference-desktop figure, so end-to-end crossing cost cannot be certified here.
active_gate_evidence: test/abi.test.mjs asserts every declared calling convention (cdecl/stdcall/fastcall/thiscall) returns a balanced guest stack across argument counts, that stdcall/cdecl assign cleanup to the correct side and the register conventions pass the first arguments in registers, that the guest->host crossing reaches host emulation on every call (measured as the recompiled path's WebAssembly import call), and that the crossing cost is reported against the declared bar with measured_on_reference_desktop false and is_bar_cleared false.
procedure: Recompile the fixture that calls host emulation through each declared calling convention.
Assert argument order, return, and stack cleanup match the reference.
Measure the boundary crossing cost against the frozen bar.
pass_criterion: Every declared convention cleans its stack correctly.
Crossing cost stays under the declared bar.
